sections.description: ST Fitness is a modern, responsive, and feature-rich WordPress theme designed for fitness professionals, gyms, health clubs, personal trainers, yoga studios, wellness centers, sports academies, and crossfit facilities. It is equally suited to bodybuilding and weightlifting gyms, workout and training blogs, pilates, aerobics and zumba studios, martial arts, boxing and MMA clubs, spa, sauna and massage centers, nutrition, diet and health coaching, physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinics, dance schools, swimming, running and cycling clubs, bootcamp and calisthenics programs, and sports or lifestyle magazines. Its clean design and intuitive layout help you create a professional website that showcases your services, training programs, class schedules, membership plans, trainers, testimonials, pricing, galleries, and success stories. Built with performance and usability in mind, ST Fitness offers a fully responsive, mobile friendly and retina ready layout that looks great on desktops, laptops, tablets, and mobile phones. The theme is SEO friendly, speed optimized, cross browser compatible and translation ready, and it works with WooCommerce so you can sell supplements, apparel, memberships and merchandise online. It ships with a live customizer, custom logo, custom header and custom background support, multiple sidebar and footer widget areas, left and right sidebar layouts, a full width template, a page loader, sticky posts and threaded comments. The theme is compatible with the drag and drop builder, allowing you to customize pages using core Gutenberg blocks without requiring coding knowledge.
